name: ketatlas
description: Interactive HTML maps for screens, workflows, and user journeys.

scripts.validate: node bin/ketatlas.js audit examples/atlas.json --root . && node bin/ketatlas.js audit templates/basic/atlas.json && node bin/ketatlas.js audit templates/web/atlas.json && node bin/ketatlas.js audit templates/process/atlas.json
scripts.check: npm run validate && npm test && npm run test:e2e
scripts.format: prettier --write src styles/ketatlas.css bin scripts docs examples starter templates tests '*.md' '*.json' .github/workflows
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src styles/ketatlas.css bin scripts docs examples starter templates tests '*.md' '*.json' .github/workflows
